name: takefive
description: Smart notification tool for Coding Agents (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity)

scripts.build: tsup && (command -v swiftc >/dev/null 2>&1 && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos12.0 src/desktop/macos/*.swift -o dist/TakeFive && cp -f dist/TakeFive dist/TakeFiveMenuBar || true)
scripts.package:windows: (command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-windows.ps1) || bash scripts/build-windows.sh

author: XianShengXingGe
